name: Goodboy v0.31.1
body: An identifier peek in the right drawer, a folded sidebar that shows only sessions with news, named session tools and a smoother stream. ### New #### Identifier peek in the right drawer Choosing any result in the identifier popover opens the right drawer and never moves the page. A changed file shows its diff scrolled to the match, and an unchanged file shows its source with a quiet one-line note. The popover lists the definition first, then changed files, then unchanged ones. A file shows once, under Defined in, with a Changed tag. A long folder path ends in an ellipsis at the start, so the folders next to the file stay whole and the file name is never cut. #### Folded sidebar shows sessions with news The folded sidebar draws only sessions that need you, are running or have unread news, in that order, up to seven. Quiet sessions fold into the +N count and stay in its flyout. In the folded session rail, a pull request is drawn as its state icon. Its number, branch and state are in the tooltip. #### Every session tool is named Each tool in the session rail carries its name under its icon, in a slightly smaller caption. The captions hide together when the window is under 480px tall, and the tooltips stay. ### Improved #### Smoother streaming in busy workspaces Streaming output no longer re-checks every sidebar, board and top bar value on each chunk, so busy workspaces stay smooth while agents write. #### Comments say what they count The fix button and the run line read Fixing 1 of 4 threads: the threads still being fixed out of the run. The comment drawer counts comments. A covered comment row reads In the fix run instead of repeating Fixing, and the Open and Resolved switch is quieter and reads as a filter. #### Help search ranks title matches first Title matches lead the results, and each guide result shows a line of context with the match marked. What's new shows three rows, with a button for the rest. ### Fixed - Setup no longer reopens at the Agents step right after your first session starts. - Branch rows keep the width of the status word, with the word in a tooltip when it is cut. - A fix run question has one Answer button on its card. - Next in the file list is drawn as a button. - Settings names the default editor, such as VS Code, before detection finishes. - The top bar usage chip with no figures shows a glyph. - Shortcuts no longer shows a Read only subtitle under its title.

name: Goodboy v0.31.0
body: One Needs you card, a Sessions page that is the Board, tabs on the branch page, a shorter setup and a quicker app, and Skills are removed. ### New #### One Needs you card Runs waiting for you, open questions and fixes to review sit in one Needs you card on the session Overview. It reads Nothing needs you when it is empty. New since you looked is one row after it that opens to the three newest. A branch without a pull request reads No PR, and one branch alone draws no Branches card. #### Tabs on the branch page The branch page has a tab strip under its title: Pull request, Comments, Files, Commits and Checks, each with its count. In the sidebar a branch is one row with one pill, and its pages are those tabs. #### A shorter setup Setup is three steps: Agents, Workspace and First session. Welcome is the head of the Agents step, and Linear or Jira connect from the first session step. The Setup card shows on an empty Board, reads as a compact checklist with a progress meter, puts the open step first with one button and folds finished steps into one line. #### Run defaults in one place Run defaults is one page in Settings, under This workspace, and the Workflows studio no longer has a Run defaults tab. The start form, Auto and that page share one limit, and the Auto limit you had is folded in. On the start form, settings read Label: value and tint when changed. Asks you, Limit and Guidance wait under More until they differ, and a chip links to the page that owns its default with Change default. #### One Help window Guide, What's new and Shortcuts are one Help window with one search. Shortcuts is a read only sheet that links to Settings to change keys. Windows that replace the sidebar show Back to app with Esc, and their Close buttons are gone. #### Ask this session Ask has its own icon, reads Ask this session on hover and opens with a Scope chip naming the session. Questions use the same bubble as Chat, and Start work from chat adds a brief to the session you are asking about. ### Improved #### The Board is the Sessions page The Sessions page shows the Board only. The list lives in the sidebar with one filter menu, and finished sessions close it in a Done group that starts shut. Mark all sessions as read is in the palette. The top bar no longer counts what needs you, and its running slot reads Idle when nothing runs, so nothing slides. #### Comments grouped by what needs you Comments group as Needs you, Working and Done, and read Question, Fix to review and Fixed. One header button follows the state, and fixes count threads. A comment is a Draft in the list until it is posted. The header shows open, need-you and unread thread counts, and the pull request page no longer repeats the commit and file counts in its two cards. #### Diffs on a narrow window Under about 1470px the file list folds behind a Files button, and Split is greyed with Needs 880px. The file list head reads Viewed 2 of 6 with a Next button, and rows show a check instead of a second checkbox. Diff bodies load as each file scrolls into view and show a skeleton or a Retry while they load. #### A lighter agent page The agent page header drops the Stop chip and the Running word, and View transcript sits in the menu. Stop is the square in the message box. Each Auto delegation is one line with its role, task, state and time. Picking up reads Continue everywhere, and Resume, Resume run and Continue the run are gone. #### A goal can name an existing branch A goal that names an existing branch uses that branch instead of cutting a new one, and two names offer a picker. When the branch is checked out in another worktree, you can open that worktree or start on a new branch. A run whose planner is reworking the plan shows as Revising plan with the time the planner has worked, and Review plan returns when it is done. #### Switching workspace The top bar chip names the workspace you are opening at once and the board shows its loading state. A failed switch says Couldn't open with the name and a Retry, and leaves the current workspace untouched. #### A quicker app The Branch page, artifacts, the wireframe reader, the file diff drawer and the database migration code load when you first need them, so the app starts faster. The download is smaller too. Loading skeletons no longer flash on fast loads and fade out when data arrives. Opening a session from the board cross-fades, and the board comes back at the same scroll. A lens you leave keeps its scroll and open items. #### Skills are removed There is no Skills page in Settings and no slash skill prefix in the composer. A message starting with a slash sends as plain text. Skill files in .goodboy/skills, .kay/skills or .claude/skills are ignored by this version, and your saved skill rows stay in the database. ### Fixed - The branch header and the Push button quote the same number of commits not pushed, and say when origin has commits you lack. - A finished run or agent no longer shows a needs-you count, and the open question stays on the Needs you card. - A failed start says why and offers Connect a provider or Copy details. - A refused token on Tasks says Reconnect and opens the tool's settings. - Unread works for older GitLab and Bitbucket connections without reconnecting. - A queued message is never sent twice after a crash. - Archiving or restoring a session as the window regains focus no longer lets an older read undo it. - Terminal scrollback files are private to you and removed after a week if the tab never returns. - Rebase on main stays reachable from Branch actions while the branch is behind and another step leads. - The board skeleton no longer hangs when there is nothing to check. - The notification bell shows its count alone, without a second dot.

name: Goodboy v0.30.0
body: The pull request page counts the review threads you have not read, and Comments marks them for that visit. This version updates your data in one direction. To go back to 0.29, restore the backup Goodboy made before updating. ### New #### Unread review threads The line at the top of the pull request page now also counts the threads you have not read yet, after the open ones and the ones that need you. In Comments, each unread thread gets a dot in the margin for that visit. Your own replies never make a thread unread, and threads from before the update count as read.

name: Goodboy v0.29.10
body: Needs you reads like Waiting for you, and a stopped run shows its open questions. ### Improved #### Needs you reads like Waiting for you Needs you drops its grey group bars. Decide and Fix are quiet labels with a count, shown only when both are there, and every row lines up with the rows of Waiting for you. #### A stopped run shows its questions A run that stopped on its limit, on a failure or because you stopped it shows its open questions on the run page, where you can answer them. On every question card, Blocking sits on the top row with the pager and the question starts on its own line below.

name: Goodboy v0.29.9
body: Pictures in What's new show whole, images as thumbnails with a viewer, hints on the run track, and fixes for multi repo runs and the terminal. ### Improved #### Images as thumbnails Images in a message or a run goal show as one row of thumbnails that fits the message, with a count for the rest. Other files keep their chip. #### A viewer with every image Opening an image shows the others from the same message in a rail on the left. Move with the arrow keys or a click, and Escape takes you back to the thumbnail. #### Hints on the run track A hint is a round node on the run's line, with its text, its images and a link to the step that read it. A long hint opens with Show more. ### Fixed - Pictures in What's new show whole, at their own shape, instead of zoomed in and cut at the sides. - In a project with several repositories, the orchestrator sees every mount and sends each step to the right one. - The terminal panel opens in the installed app again. - After you move to another open question, keys 1 to 4 pick on that question.

name: Goodboy v0.29.8
body: Agents grouped by state, answers under each question, a smaller blocking question, and a quieter header and sidebar. ### Improved #### Agents grouped by state In an Auto run the Agents rail shows Working, Waiting and Done with a count each and one summary line. Done stays folded while others work. Each row shows its full title, then the role and time. #### Questions show their answer An answered question shows the answer on a second line under it, marked You or Agent, instead of a cut off column. In Artifacts, each state is a word with a small dot. #### A smaller blocking question A question that blocks an agent is one quiet card: Blocking sits beside the question, the choices are plain numbered rows, and Let an agent decide shares a line with Answer. #### Quieter header and sidebar The limit and the other settings under the session title show their border only on hover or focus. In the sidebar, group labels are small and faint, project names stand out and branch names are muted.

name: Goodboy v0.29.7
body: Five clear text levels across the app, answers with real code blocks and tables, and pages where labels, names and the live step stand apart. ### Improved #### Five text levels Titles read at 18 on 28, headings, prose, rows and meta each have their own size, and figures line up only where they are numbers, such as costs, times and counts. #### Answers with code blocks and tables A code block has a header with its language, Wrap and Copy, and is never cut by Show more. Tables have quiet headers, one line between rows and numbers aligned right. #### Overview and runs read in groups Group labels stand above their rows with room between groups, a row's name leads it, the Runs page opens with one line, and the step that runs now is the strongest line on the run page. ### Fixed - Orchestrated and Preset start from the Run defaults limit; Auto and a start with no kind start from the Auto limit. A typed amount stays for a retry. - A long answer never stops on a heading with nothing under it; it stops after the last whole paragraph or list. - The Runs list fits its card at any width: origin and model hide first when the list is narrow.

name: Goodboy v0.29.6
body: Answers keep their headings apart, Show more lines up with the text, Stop appears once, and the picked Next step choice is easy to see. ### Improved #### Answers read in clear sections A heading inside an answer sits 24px under the text before it and close to the text it opens. A long answer stops at the end of its last whole block, and Show more lines up with the text. #### The picked choice stands out In Auto's Next step card the picked choice is filled and outlined like any selected row, and Recommended is quiet text beside the advised one. ### Fixed - A running agent shows Stop in its header and in the message box only, not again on the Writing the answer line.

name: Goodboy v0.29.5
body: Agent chats read in a calm column with room between turns, a sent message stays in view, and the Next step card is short and quiet. ### Improved #### Agent chats read in one calm column The chat, its header and the message box sit in one 720px column. Messages read larger with more room between lines, turns and blocks stand apart, and a long answer shows 12 lines before Show more. Copy appears when you point at a message or tab to it. #### Your message stays where you can read it When you send, your message moves near the top and the reply grows below it. The view no longer jumps while you read, Jump to latest brings you back, and the last line never sits against the message box. #### The Next step card is short and quiet Auto's Next step is one neutral card with a status dot. The choices sit in one row with Recommended as a quiet tag, a hint opens only when you ask for it, and one button starts the step.

name: Goodboy v0.29.4
body: One start form for every way in, a limit that is exactly what the form shows, and guidance that reaches every kind of run. ### Improved #### One start form for every way in New session, a session's Runs page, ⌘K and setup's Scout run share one form. Pick Auto, Agent, Orchestrated or Preset, or press none and Auto picks. One row of chips holds Where, Role, Model, Asks you, Edits, Limit and Guidance, and each kind shows only what it uses. #### Guidance for every kind of run Guidance starts from your workspace text and can change for one run. Orchestrated and Preset hand it to the orchestrator, an agent reads it in its brief, and an Auto agent and its helpers read it on every turn. #### Answer a run's questions on its page A run's page shows its questions as the same card as the transcript, with the suggested answers, the recommended one and one or many picks. Several questions page as 1 of 2 and the last Answer sends them together. #### A step that lost its branch says so A run step whose branch was detached from the session shows as waiting for that branch, with Reattach, Use the session's branch or Pick a branch. A new hint waits instead of adding another stuck step, and detaching a branch a run uses asks first. ### Fixed - A run step no longer gets a reminder to continue while its agent waits on your answer, so the same question is not asked again. - When an agent asks again, its earlier open questions in the run close, and answering the newest one moves the run. - The transcript card says how many questions are left and jumps to the next one. - A run gets the limit the form showed: No limit means no limit, and the run page says whether the amount is the default or set for this run. - The limit menu names the session limit and each provider's monthly limit, with what is already spent. - A run started from the chat or a suggestion now stops at the Run defaults limit it shows. - Edits on the start form sets what agents may do in the session before the first one starts. - The Model chip looks and works the same on New session and on a session's Runs page. - Agents reply and ask in the language of the session goal, which their instructions now name, instead of guessing it. - An agent that finds missing dependencies runs the install command for the lockfile instead of asking you how. - Auto's replies no longer break a word into two paragraphs, and its hand over notes no longer show as raw text. - A planner is no longer refused for a task that says not to run a command, and every refusal says what to change. - When Auto keeps being refused, the chat says why and offers Retry instead of stopping in silence.

name: Goodboy v0.29.3
body: Runs and agents read like a person wrote them, every agent shows its model by name, and every failure links to its transcript. ### Improved #### Runs and agents read in plain words New since you last looked and Done show each run as its kind, its agent count and its progress, such as Orchestrated, 3 agents, 3 of 5 steps, and say only what needs you. Agent rows show their role and provider, and titles drop tags, hashes and slash lists. #### The Agents panel keeps every launch in view A run you started never folds away. A finished run keeps one line under it with its helper count and the most urgent state, and an agent with helpers folds to a count such as 2 helpers, Failed. A fold opens by itself when a hidden helper needs you. #### Agent cards name their model and open in one click Auto's agent cards, the Agents panel and the Runs grid show the model by name with its effort, such as Sonnet 5.5 High, never a routing id. A whole Auto card opens its agent; Stop is in its right click menu and on the agent's page. ### Fixed - A failed turn has View transcript next to Retry, which opens the transcript at the call that failed. - A blocked Auto run shows its whole reason on up to two lines, with the full text on hover or focus. - A run that needs a human call offers View transcript. - Retry, Stop and Message this agent each appear once on a screen instead of twice. - A model Goodboy no longer lists keeps its name instead of showing its raw id. - The limit chip reads Limit $5.00 and says default until you change it, and its menu names the run it limits. - A single agent no longer shows a spending limit it would not stop at. - Tooltips open beside what they describe and stay inside the window, and a cut title shows its full text on hover or keyboard focus. - Model, run settings, Asks you and limit menus open next to their button at a steady width, never past the window edge.

name: Goodboy v0.29.2
body:
Agents follow what the session already decided, a run's steps stay on its branch, and a hint image reaches the agent that acts on it.

### Fixed

- Agents follow an active session decision instead of asking you to confirm it, even when it was written as an assumption. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- The orchestrator names the decisions that govern a step in its brief, so the step never has to find them. <!-- gb area=workflows -->
- A run's steps stay on the branch the run started on, even when another agent adds a branch or you switch branch. <!-- gb area=workflows -->
- A step whose branch was removed stops and names the branch instead of starting in another worktree. <!-- gb area=workflows -->
- The orchestrator looks at the images of your hints and writes what they show into the step brief, and the step gets those images by path. <!-- gb area=workflows -->
- Agents in a worktree install dependencies there instead of linking node_modules or build output from another folder. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- The orchestrator and the planner can only read files, never run commands or edit, even when your settings allow more. <!-- gb area=workflows -->

name: Goodboy v0.29.1
body: A run that asks several questions shows them all on its page, and you answer them in one go. ### Improved #### Answer every question of a run at once When the agent of a run asks several questions, the run page lists each one with its own answer field and one Send answers button. The agent gets every answer together and resumes once; a failed send keeps what you typed and Retry sends the same answers again. ### Fixed - An answer saved on the run page that did not reach the agent stays there with the error and Retry, which sends it again without saving twice. - A question another agent is already answering shows as waiting on the run page and is left out of the answers you send.

name: Goodboy v0.29.0
body: Auto asks you as much as you want, proposes its next step as a card, and its agents answer in one short reading order. ### New #### Choose how much Auto asks you Auto has an Asks you level: Every step, After the plan or Never. Pick it in Start a run, change it from the running agent's settings line, and set a workspace default in Settings, separate from the workflow one. At Every step each agent waits for your go; After the plan, the default, waits only for the plan; Never runs on its own. #### Auto proposes its next step as a card Auto no longer ends on a yes or no question in prose. It proposes the next agent as a card with one main action, up to two alternatives and a hint field, and keys 1 to 3 pick. A hint you add travels with the agent's brief and survives a retry. ### Improved #### The plan card opens the plan The Auto plan card shows the first steps and their file and risk counts, with View plan as the main action. Approve plan sits at the top right of the plan view and keeps the run inside Auto. An approved plan stays in the chat in the artifact colour. #### Agents answer in one reading order Every agent message starts with a one line outcome, then its artifacts, then chips, with the rest folded under Notes. Goodboy corrects the outcome when checks fail or a push did not go through, and an Auto child's result card follows the same order. #### Auto plans without the plan mode The Claude Auto lead runs outside the CLI plan mode, so it writes a real plan instead of a prose one, and stays limited to reading and searching. #### Open a folder from the Changes card A folder in the Changes card of a pull request opens Files showing only that folder, and Clear brings the whole tree back. ### Fixed - If Auto did not hear a saved plan approval, the plan view offers Tell Auto instead of closing. - Auto reads the Asks you level fresh at each handoff, so another window's change applies, and a pending confirmation survives a switch to Never. - A decline from another window no longer cancels a child you just confirmed.

name: Goodboy v0.28.7
body: Auto shows its agents at work and their artifacts, pull requests open on two short cards, and commits fit on one line. ### Improved #### See Auto's agents at work A running Auto child shows as a live card in the chat with its state, how long it has run, what it is doing right now, Open and Stop. A Working now strip above the message field lists the agents still running. Opening a child from the chat reveals its row in Agents while Auto stays in view. #### Messages to a busy Auto say what they wait for A message you send to Auto while its agents work reads "Waits for" under it, with Send now to hand it to Auto at once without stopping the agents. #### A pull request opens on two short cards The Pull request page of a branch opens on Commits and Changes cards instead of a list of every commit and file, and each card opens its tab. A branch with an open pull request counts its open review threads and the ones that need you. #### Compact commits with day headings The Commits list uses one line per commit under day headings and keeps squash, reorder and the other history actions. Your own commits drop the author name, and other authors show as initials with the full name on hover. #### The Agents panel follows you The Agents panel scrolls to the agent you are on and opens the fold that hides it. Its rows line up in clean icon, chevron and time columns. ### Fixed - A report, wireframe or plan an Auto agent produced shows in the Auto chat as a card you can open, with the agent's notes folded away. - Auto no longer loses an agent it decided to start when the app restarts its recovery while the answer is still being saved. - A message to an Auto conversation that is blocked or stopped no longer looks sent; it says Not delivered, with the reason. - Auto delivers a waiting message once its agents have all ended instead of keeping it waiting. - The Scribe opens pull requests against the base branch name instead of failing on origin/main. - The collapsed sidebar shows only a dot on a door, without a number that overlaps the icon. - Auto says a scout that wrote no report ended without one, instead of claiming its result could not be saved, and keeps a blocked scout blocked. - Auto no longer sends a reviewer to audit a commit range it cannot read without git; it routes that work to an agent with a shell before any spend. - A message waiting for Auto no longer vanishes when you stop Auto; it shows as Not delivered. - The clock on a running Auto child counts its whole active time, matching Working now and the Agents panel. - The Changes card of a pull request keeps the whole branch while the Files tab shows one commit. - Auto briefs name the pull request, threads and checks of each mount they mention, and say unknown instead of none when a mount was not read.

name: Goodboy v0.28.6
body:
Runs name their model, steps finish when the agent is done, plan parts stop colliding, and merged branches offer a clean up.

### Improved

#### Pick the model of a run where it starts
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

Start a run and the New session page show a Model chip next to Run as. It names the model the Auto agent or the orchestrator uses, follows your default, and lets you pick another one for that run only.

An orchestrated run shows its Orchestrator model next to Kind, and Settings > Models opens with a Runs section for the Auto agent and the Orchestrator.

#### A step that ends without a result says so
<!-- gb area=workflows -->

A step whose agent stopped without saying it is done reads "This step ended without a result", with Continue and Mark step done on the run page and the agent page. Goodboy also reads the done, question, plan and hand-off markers however an agent writes them.

#### Plan parts run in waves
<!-- gb area=workflows -->

The planner names each part and the parts it comes after. The plan page groups parts into Runs first and Then, in parallel, shows the files of each part, and names a file two parts share and the order it forces. A part you start by hand while another works on the same files waits and says which part it waits for.

#### Merged branches are work complete
<!-- gb area=review -->

A merged branch says Merged, work complete and offers Clean up, which removes its folder and local branch after one inline confirmation and refuses when work would be lost. Clean up N merged handles several branches of a session at once.

#### See what is new in a session
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

A session with unseen activity lists it under New since you last looked at the top of its overview, with Mark all seen, and its blue dot says what is new on hover.

#### Push fixes stay in view
<!-- gb area=review -->

The Fix the push card keeps showing the agent, its progress and its result when you leave the page or reload. Before a push, a worktree with missing dependencies, or one that reads them from another folder, gets Reinstall dependencies, which installs them there and retries the push.

#### Answer a run's question on the run page
<!-- gb area=workflows -->

A run waiting for your answer shows the question on the run page with an answer field, so you can reply without opening the agent chat.

#### Copilot in setup
<!-- gb area=providers -->

Copilot appears in the agents step of setup, next to the other agents.

#### Page crashes leave a trace
<!-- gb area=app -->

If a page of the app crashes, its error, stack and component path are written to the local app log so the cause can be found.

### Fixed

- A step no longer waits forever when its agent leaves a command running in the background after it said it was done. <!-- gb area=workflows -->
- Writing to an agent that is still wrapping up no longer starts a second copy of it on the same conversation. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- A plan no longer runs two parts on the same files at once; parts that share a file go one after the other. <!-- gb area=workflows -->
- A merged branch no longer shows the behind-main dot, a behind count, rebase offers or an old rebase conflict. <!-- gb area=review -->
- When the orchestrator cannot start the step it decided on, your queued hints stay queued instead of being marked as read. <!-- gb area=workflows -->
- Session and agent titles no longer keep a "Title:" label or a leaked sentence. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- A fix run over more than 12 comments shows every comment as Fixing, not only the first 12. <!-- gb area=review -->
- Each Copilot turn after the first shows only its own premium requests, not the whole session's. <!-- gb area=providers -->
- Read-only Copilot runs refuse extra permission flags even when they are written with a value. <!-- gb area=providers -->
- Storage counts the Claude Code sessions Goodboy runs in its scratch folders and history copies, and says the sizes are saved sessions, not worktrees. <!-- gb area=storage -->
- The Running list group under Needs you reads Waiting for you instead of repeating the title. <!-- gb area=sessions -->

name: Goodboy v0.28.5
body:
Copilot joins as a provider, and the Running list, the step bar and the session tools read at a glance.

### New

#### Copilot is a provider
<!-- gb area=providers -->

Connect the Copilot command line tool, pick its models in the model picker and run turns on it. A Copilot turn shows how many premium requests it used instead of a cost, and Goodboy keeps a classic GitHub token out of Copilot runs because Copilot refuses it.

### Improved

#### The Running list groups what you do next
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

The Running list on the session overview is grouped into Needs you, Running and Stopped. Each row shows one short status with the cause on a second line, and durations line up in one column, also for the agents under a run.

#### Session tools run from reading to acting
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

The tools at the right of a session run Explore, Context, then Ask, Agents, Scripts, and the Terminal last, with a thin line between the groups. The count of sessions that need you is a small dot and a quiet number, red only when something is broken.

### Fixed

- The step bar of a run is colored by state, never by role, so green no longer reads as passed. <!-- gb area=sessions -->

name: Goodboy v0.28.4
body:
Runs, start a run, review comments and failed pushes now say what is going on and what you can do next.

### Improved

#### Start a run says what it starts
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

Start a run has a Run as choice (Auto, Orchestrated, a preset or a role) and the same ~ and @ menus as the chat box, and the line under the box says what Start does. It also takes images and files with the paperclip, paste or drop.

#### A blocked run shows its question
<!-- gb area=workflows -->

A step that stopped on a question shows it on the run page with an Answer field, Restart step as a secondary button and Open agent chat. A run the orchestrator stopped on a human call says why and offers Add a hint and continue instead of Retry.

#### Fix run comments show where they stand
<!-- gb area=review -->

Comments covered by a fix run say Fixing, Fixed in a commit with See diff, or why the fix failed. A finished fix run groups its comments under "Fix run finished: N fixes ready for you" with Apply and resolve, and warns when its checks were skipped.

#### A failed push says why
<!-- gb area=review -->

When a push stops on a repository check, the failure names the check and shows its first findings, and Let an agent fix the push starts an agent on the same branch that fixes it without skipping the check.

### Fixed

- An Auto run no longer gets a 5 dollar limit you never set: a limit exists only when you set one, and No limit removes it. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- A run's title no longer shows a leaked reply such as "Title: the user asked for a"; titles already saved are cleaned when they load. <!-- gb area=workflows -->
- Items under Left that name no role no longer show as steps, and a planned step that repeats an existing one shows once. <!-- gb area=workflows -->
- The Kind menu of a running run is read-only, and Restart as on a stopped run ends it instead of starting a second run on the same branch. <!-- gb area=workflows -->
- Comments you just sent to a fix run no longer come back selected when the fix is ready. <!-- gb area=review -->
- The Comments view no longer says "Nothing is waiting for the push" right after a push failed. <!-- gb area=review -->

name: Goodboy v0.28.3
body:
Files you drop on a message box attach again.

### Fixed

- Dropping an image or a file on a message box, a hint or a new run showed "Couldn't attach" for any file, whatever its size; the file now attaches. <!-- gb area=sessions -->

name: Goodboy v0.28.2
body:
A new install of Goodboy opens again on its first start, and so does an update from an older version.

### Fixed

- A new install, or an update from an older version, could stop at the first start with "Migration failed: authorization denied"; it now starts and migrates your data. <!-- gb area=storage -->

name: Goodboy v0.28.1
body:
> [!CAUTION]
> A new install of this version can stop at start with "Migration failed: authorization denied". Install 0.28.2, which fixes it for new installs and updates alike.

Goodboy opens again after the update that stopped it at start, with your updated data kept.

### Fixed

- Goodboy 0.28.0 could stop at start with "Migration failed: authorization denied"; it now starts and keeps the data 0.28.0 already updated. <!-- gb area=storage -->

name: Goodboy v0.28.0
body:
> [!CAUTION]
> BREAKING: this version can stop at start with "Migration failed: authorization denied". Do not install it: install 0.28.2, which fixes it and keeps your data.

Needs you counts everywhere, agents stop and resume cleanly, terminals re-run what they ran, and set up, shortcuts and security get sturdier.

This version updates your data in one direction. To go back to 0.27, restore the backup Goodboy made before updating.

### New

#### Needs you counts across sessions and workspaces
<!-- gb area=sessions screen=notifications -->

A card in Needs you says why, in the board and the list, and its round button goes where the reason clears. A run that stopped, paused at its limit or waits for you, an Auto agent that needs your OK and a Slack reply waiting for approval all count, longest wait first.

The Sessions door shows how many sessions need you, red when one is broken, and the Now chip leads with the same count. The workspace picker, the launcher and the dock badge add up your other workspaces too.

Goodboy shows a system banner and a number on the app icon when a session needs you while you are in another app, with two switches in Settings, General, Notifications. Mark a session as unread or read from its row or from several picked rows.

#### Stop an agent from its message box
<!-- gb area=agents -->

A running agent has a Stop square in the message box and a Stop in its header. Esc pressed twice stops it, a slow stop reads Stopping and then offers Force stop, and Stop all running agents stops every running agent of a session in one action.

Deny answers only the call in front of you. Never allow in the card's menu is the session-wide ban and names the command, and the always-allow buttons resume the blocked call without a Retry click.

#### Copy, re-run and send back what an agent ran
<!-- gb area=scripts -->

Commands an agent ran can be copied, re-run in a terminal (typed, never run for you) or sent back to the agent from their card. Shell blocks in messages get Copy and Run in terminal. Ask the agent about a script's or terminal's output in one click: it lands as an attachment on the composer.

Click a file path with a line number in the terminal or a script's output (Cmd-click in the terminal) to open your editor at that line. A busy terminal tab shows the process it runs, and the close question names it.

#### Terminals and scripts survive a restart
<!-- gb area=scripts -->

After a restart, a terminal that ran a command shows "ended when Goodboy quit" with Run it again, Scripts offers to start the services that were running, and Restart on an exited terminal runs its last command again.

Scripts and Terminal in the session tools column show a dot when a script runs or fails, and a script that ends in another session raises a toast with Open output. Start all services starts the whole stack. Open in terminal app is in the session, branch, worktree and Files folder menus, with a Terminal choice in Settings, Open with.

#### Set up clones a repository and finds your folders
<!-- gb area=app -->

Set up can clone a repository from GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket into a folder you choose. The first workspace step lists the folders where your code usually lives: tick them and press Look to find your repositories.

The last step uses the same Start a run field as every session and opens on your first issue when a task tool is connected. An empty board over a repository with no commit offers Make the first commit in place.

#### Branches shows a pull request series
<!-- gb area=review -->

Branches shows Part 2 of 3 and a series strip for pull requests an agent declared as a series, and Next offers Merge in order, which stops at the first part that cannot merge.

A merge carries the commit you reviewed on GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket: if the branch moved since, nothing merges and Goodboy asks you to refresh and review again. A branch whose online copy moved reads Diverged, and the new pull request form offers Force push and create behind the usual confirm.

#### Keyboard shortcuts you can change
<!-- gb area=settings screen=settings/app -->

In Settings, Keyboard shortcuts, click a row's keys to give it another chord. Conflicts are refused and each row has a Reset. Every key hint in tooltips, the Guide and field hints comes from the same list, so a changed key shows everywhere.

Terminal tabs get previous and next, tab N and F2 rename. On Linux and Windows the view shortcuts are Ctrl+Shift+Alt plus the same key, so the desktop no longer swallows them.

#### New branches start with your ignored files and setup
<!-- gb area=settings screen=settings/workspace/projects -->

Settings can tick the git-ignored files (.env, local config) a new branch should start with, and proposes its setup (pnpm install) on the branch with a Run button. Nothing runs and no secret travels unless you choose it.

#### Backup import shows what it brings
<!-- gb area=storage screen=settings/app/storage -->

Backup import lists every allow rule and script, refuses a file that changed after the preview, needs its own consent for allow-anything rules, and brings scripts in disabled. A restore brings back each workspace's After merge setting.

Storage says when a terminal keeps a clean folder from going and closes it on a click, and offers Undo after a removal.

#### Continue a stopped turn at a time you choose
<!-- gb area=providers screen=settings/providers -->

A usage limit with no other provider to move to offers Continue at 18:40 on the stopped turn. Nothing starts until you click it, and you can cancel it.

Provider limits trip at the same point everywhere: spend that reaches the cap counts as over it, and the budget month follows your local calendar.

### Improved

#### Recover when the database cannot open
<!-- gb area=app -->

When Goodboy cannot open its database, the start screen offers Retry first, then Move aside and restart, which keeps the old file next to a new empty one. A crash in one page, drawer or studio shows a recoverable message in that panel instead of replacing the whole window.

#### The overview states where the task stands
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

The overview shows the one-sentence State of the task under the goal, with when it was written, gray when it is old or when a pull request moved after it. The Done card lists the last three finished items with who did them, how long ago and a dot when the reply is unread.

When every branch of a session is merged or closed, Next offers Archive this session, and the Done lane has a menu to archive everything in it or what is older than 7 days, each with Undo.

#### One look for icons, forms, menus and motion
<!-- gb area=app -->

Icons share one size ladder and one stroke weight. Form fields type at 13px, disabled controls share one look, menus, bars and drag ghosts share one floating surface, and motion uses three durations and two curves. Looping working signs pause in a hidden window.

The sidebar ranks Sessions and Tasks first, then Workflows, Chat and Terminal. The theme moved from the top bar to Settings and the palette, and the top bar says Search or run.

#### Settings, General has a More contrast switch
<!-- gb area=settings screen=settings/app -->

More contrast is also on when your system asks for it. A screen reader hears one sentence per finished turn and when a session needs you, instead of every transcript row.

### Fixed

- Merge, mark ready, reopen, convert to draft and close act on the repository of the branch on screen, and GitLab and Bitbucket review comments refresh on their own. <!-- gb area=review -->
- Sessions fall back to Ask first, never Full access, when a workspace or its saved permission mode is missing or unknown; new workspaces still start on Full access. <!-- gb area=settings -->
- Permission globs match in linear time and a single `*` no longer crosses `;`, `&&` or `|`; issue and check text reaches agents inside an untrusted block. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- A turn can no longer use another workspace's integration credentials through the bridge, and the bridge socket limits line size, users, connections and idle time. <!-- gb area=integrations -->
- The phone connection limits idle and flooding connections, hides deleted sessions and absolute paths, and refuses an agent that is not in the session. <!-- gb area=app -->
- A new iPhone asks for your OK before it pairs, each paired iPhone has a name and its own Revoke, and iPhone turns run at Edits allowed at most. <!-- gb area=app -->
- A prompt with a pasted key no longer shows in the process list for Claude and Codex runs, and the monitor hides prompt text. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- The app refuses raw database statements and git revisions that could write files outside its own folders. <!-- gb area=storage -->
- Files the app reads or deletes for you are checked against the folder they belong to, so a bad link or a stray path can no longer reach other files. <!-- gb area=storage -->
- Provider install and login, editor launch and file open run only from fixed lists; executable files are no longer opened from Open. <!-- gb area=providers -->
- Connected GitLab, Jira and Bitbucket accounts send their token only to the host they were connected with, and GitLab and Jira connections need https. <!-- gb area=integrations -->
- Goodboy's data folder and database files are readable only by you, and leftover temporary chat folders from a crash are cleaned up at start. <!-- gb area=storage -->
- Bug reports, the process monitor and git errors hide the same set of keys, including Linear, Sentry, Atlassian and Slack app tokens and bearer values. <!-- gb area=app -->
- Forgetting a key removes it at once, API key checks say valid, rejected or not checked and never print the key, and a failed save leaves no key behind. <!-- gb area=providers -->
- GitHub actions stop with a clear error when the saved key cannot be read, instead of silently using the account signed in to gh. <!-- gb area=integrations -->
- A message full of nested notes or hostile text no longer freezes or crashes the window; it shows as plain text. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- A link that cannot be opened shows a notification instead of reporting a crash, and mailto links are plain text. <!-- gb area=app -->
- Remote images refuse more reserved network ranges, and unexpected keys in model output can no longer slip past validation. <!-- gb area=app -->
- Undoing an archive whose sessions could not be restored says nothing changed instead of Undone. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- A broken artifact no longer hides the rest of a session's artifacts. <!-- gb area=artifacts -->
- Saving a workspace setting writes only that setting, so a second window can no longer undo another one's change, and a refused value shows its name. <!-- gb area=settings -->
- Pinned sessions, the Auto limit, the terminal folder and a folder's face go with the workspace or folder when you delete it, and nothing is left behind. <!-- gb area=settings -->
- A setting that folders override says how many folders use their own value, and a folder's own After merge rule is marked From project. <!-- gb area=settings screen=settings/workspace/projects -->
- A setting you save in one window shows in your other windows at once, and a reply is marked seen only when the window is in front. <!-- gb area=settings -->
- Background screens stop checking terminals, ports and Auto agents while the window is hidden, and idle Auto sessions stop polling. <!-- gb area=app -->
- Send looks and is named the same in the session, Ask and Chat composers, and a refused send never overwrites what you typed meanwhile. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- Every comment box saves with cmd+Enter, cancels with Esc one layer at a time and shows the same buttons; long reply threads fold the same way everywhere. <!-- gb area=review -->
- Stopping a Chat answer before the provider has started stops it for good, as it already did in Ask. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- Image preview opens as a proper modal: focus lands on Close, Tab stays inside, and focus returns to where you were. <!-- gb area=app -->
- Rail flyouts and session hover cards follow their anchor on scroll and resize, and the task drag ghost no longer slips under popovers. <!-- gb area=app -->
- A session with no title reads Untitled session in the Now popover, toasts and the rail, and the switcher shows last seen as 5m ago. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- The Files tree indents each level by 12px, like the Changes tree. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- Auto agents and CI fixer have their own colors, and placeholders, integration chip labels and control borders keep consistent contrast on every surface. <!-- gb area=app -->
- Chained starts (After another workflow) can no longer be created; runs saved by an older release with it keep working. <!-- gb area=workflows -->
- The New session field reads Goal, the Scripts pane groups Services and Commands, and failed turns say The turn failed. <!-- gb area=app -->
- Skills you write in Goodboy are saved in .goodboy/skills of your folder; skills already in .kay/skills keep working until 0.31.0. <!-- gb area=settings -->
- Opening the bell marks only what you saw as read, and the bell scrolls past eight rows, counts every unread notification and shows the number on its icon. <!-- gb area=app screen=notifications -->
- Needs action lists only what you still owe, and a link such as Open spend is marked Opened and leaves the list when you use it. <!-- gb area=inbox screen=notifications -->
- Tasks marks what arrived since you last looked with a dot and a 2 new count, and the sidebar row shows a dot for something assigned to you. <!-- gb area=inbox screen=inbox -->
- A list shows an agent that waits for a permission as Needs permission instead of Running, and the Runs page puts what needs you first. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- A running agent that has been silent and idle for 5 minutes says Quiet for N min, and a window that stops answering leaves a report you can send. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- The Agents tool lists every agent of the session, including the ones you started yourself; opening one shows it beside the tree, and j and k hop between agents. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- Switching workspace quickly no longer shows the previous workspace's sessions, and a failed load keeps the workspace you were in. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- Moving a folder into the open workspace, or merging workspaces, no longer stops running agents. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- Planner runs can be cancelled, and a stuck side job or a flood of blank agent lines no longer grows memory without bound. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- Cancelling a provider login stops everything it started, and a terminal or script that stops reading can no longer freeze the window or Stop. <!-- gb area=providers -->
- Starting a turn or a chat no longer re-runs the CLI version checks, and an agent that is still streaming keeps its history next to the live output. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- Moving a conversation to another model carries your original request and says what was carried over and what was left out; a message sent twice no longer starts two runs. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- A branch whose remote cannot be reached reports the failed fetch instead of looking up to date, and changed-file lists read non-English file names correctly. <!-- gb area=review -->
- A project whose only remote is not called origin reads as having no remote everywhere instead of being probed on one remote and pushed to another. <!-- gb area=review -->
- Moving a project's folder no longer touches a neighbor folder with a similar name, and undoing a bootstrap move keeps a branch that gained commits. <!-- gb area=storage -->
- A branch whose name contains a pipe shows in branch cleanup, and Goodboy no longer overwrites a .gitignore it cannot read. <!-- gb area=review -->
- A redirect to another host no longer receives your key, and rate-limited reads on GitLab, Bitbucket and Jira retry on their own. <!-- gb area=integrations -->
- Merge requests Goodboy opens on GitLab no longer force delete source branch, a draft title is not prefixed twice, and a hung gh command no longer wedges a card. <!-- gb area=integrations -->
- Merging a GitLab merge request from Tasks uses the merge method the project prefers, and task lists no longer show a slow answer for a workspace you left. <!-- gb area=inbox screen=inbox -->
- When the work of a session ships, Next offers to move its linked Linear or Jira item to Done, with Undo. <!-- gb area=integrations -->
- A failed push offers Retry push and says your work is still on the branch; a rejected Linear or Bitbucket sign-in offers Reconnect. <!-- gb area=app -->
- When GitLab or Bitbucket stops answering, Goodboy shows one line under the top bar with Retry, and says when the host is back. <!-- gb area=integrations -->
- An empty board shows the five lanes with one line each and a single New session; an empty Activity shows the steps a run takes. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- What was done lists the files a turn wrote, and the restore question names the other agent that wrote the same file. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- A rebase started in a terminal shows a banner with Continue, Open terminal and Abort, and a failed rebase action stays with its own branch. <!-- gb area=review -->
- Pushing from the header, the panel or after a rebase leaves the same trace: the pull request description, the edited replies and the history entry are updated. <!-- gb area=review -->
- If a pull request is opened but Goodboy cannot save its link, pressing create again links the existing request instead of opening a second. <!-- gb area=review -->
- A hint typed under Fix with agent applies when you press the verb from the Next list, the same as in the banner. <!-- gb area=review -->
- Cards on the overview, board and switcher keep their titles and actions whole at narrow widths, and long run step and card names wrap instead of being cut. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- A step whose name matches its role no longer shows the role twice, and a failed module load shows plain words instead of an error string. <!-- gb area=workflows screen=workflows/steps -->

name: Goodboy v0.27.15
body: Menus stay next to the button that opened them, and a long row wraps instead of stretching the menu across the window. ### Improved #### The more menu on a Next card stays next to its button Menus have a fixed maximum width and open under their button. A stopped rebase folded into an Update card reads as a title naming the branch that stopped, with a short detail under it, such as "Conflict in SideBarFooter.tsx, PastDue.tsx and 3 more" or "Origin moved". A long detail wraps to three lines at most. ### Fixed - A long agent reply with many unclosed plan or handoff tags no longer stalls the transcript while it renders: the tags are now stripped in one pass over the text.

name: Goodboy v0.27.14
body: Auto runs on Cursor again, Codex agents can rebase in their worktree, and pull request writes act on the branch on screen. ### Improved #### The session tool rail shows icons only Ask, Terminal, Explore, Context, Agents and Scripts are icons in a narrow rail, with the name and shortcut on hover. The Context dot sits on its icon. ### Fixed - Auto runs on Cursor again: read-only Cursor runs pass the workspace trust flag that recent Cursor CLIs ask for, and still get no write rights. - A Codex agent can now rebase, merge and commit inside a session worktree, where git keeps its own folder outside the worktree. Before, git stopped with Operation not permitted. - Pull request actions, reviewers, linked issues and Scribe text go to the repository of the branch on screen, and a refused review request says why. - Needs you no longer asks you to approve a plan, or says Auto is stuck, for an agent that was deleted; deleting an agent closes its Auto run. - Opening the bell no longer marks every notification read: a row is read after a second on screen, and Mark all read clears the rest. - An Auto agent waiting for your OK or your answer no longer reads Queued with Stop agent; it says what it waits for. - The run's spend cap chip now counts the whole session against the session limit instead of only the run's spend. - Script output keeps accents, check marks and emoji whole, also when a character arrives split across two chunks. - The unread reply button on a board card now opens the agent that replied, not the first agent of the session. - A review thread's new on origin preview now reads the commit in the thread's own repository and says when it cannot read it. - Change folder in a terminal clears what is typed on the prompt first, so a half-typed command never runs with the cd glued to it.

name: Goodboy v0.27.13
body:
The Pull request page leads with its one next step, the Overview sorts a session into five cards, and Asks you sets when a run stops for you.

### New

#### The Pull request page leads with its next step
<!-- gb area=review -->

The branch header's one button is the next step: Request review, Fix checks, Fix comments, Mark ready for review, the merge method, Push or Rebase on main. Other actions wait in the ⋯ menu with their reason. A strip under the title says Checks, Review, Merge and Branch once, and Checks opens its tab.

Reviewers sit in a side column with their verdict, bots that only commented are listed apart, and bot comments in a row fold into one activity event.

#### A branch with no pull request gets its own page
<!-- gb area=review -->

Every branch row lands on Pull request. With no pull request yet, the page names the branch, says whether it is pushed and how far ahead or behind it is, and offers Push or Rebase on main. Its strip shows Local checks: Passed or Declined from the last pre-push hook since Goodboy started, else Not run. The create form below reads the branch on screen.

#### The Overview sorts a session into five cards
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

Needs you, Running, Next, Branches and Done, in that order, each with its count, and an empty card stays hidden. Running rows show the kind, the step bar and the run's own primary button. Branches rank what blocks you first, and Next puts the row that unblocks the most on top.

Open the full log, in the session menu and `⌘K`, shows the whole log.

#### Asks you sets when a run stops for you
<!-- gb area=workflows -->

Asks you replaces Autonomy, and its values Every step, After the plan and Never replace Ask me, Balanced and Autopilot for runs. Search still finds the old names, and the session's own Autopilot keeps its name.

Asks you is a chip on the run page, in Run defaults and on the New session page for Orchestrated and Preset workflows, where it opens on Every step.

### Improved

#### Each run setting opens its own popover
<!-- gb area=workflows -->

The run page shows a line of chips: Kind, Asks you, Limit and Models, each with one popover that names where its value comes from. A limit applies on Enter or when the popover closes, and a Models change has Undo. Once work started, the Kind chip starts a second run with the same goal, and the first one keeps going.

#### One button leads each run page
<!-- gb area=workflows -->

The run header shows one primary: Answer, Raise limit, the next step, or Pause and Resume run. Stop run moved to the ⋯ menu, behind its confirm.

#### Agent and Auto pages share the chip line
<!-- gb area=agents -->

Agent and Auto agent pages show their settings as chips above the composer, which keeps only the message. An Auto limit never passes the session limit: the smaller one wins, and lowering the session limit pauses a running Auto at its next turn once it reaches the new limit.

#### Run defaults use the same chips
<!-- gb area=settings -->

Settings, Run defaults sets Asks you, Limit, Models and the Auto limit with the run page's chips. While a session is open, New runs in this session start as sets that session's default, with Undo.

#### Session tools say their names
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

Session tools show a word beside the icon. Archive, Delete and Restore moved from the rail foot to More session actions next to Pin, and Spend and limit opens the session spend.

### Fixed

- The branch header gives up its button and push while the rebase panel shows a stop, and Push works the same from both. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- On GitLab, the merge request form opens from the branch on screen, with its title and description filled in. <!-- gb area=review -->
- Branch tabs, Checks and pull request actions read the branch on screen, not the session's write branch. <!-- gb area=review -->
- A merge held by an open rebase stop says to resolve the stop instead of pointing at a hidden Rebase button. <!-- gb area=review -->

name: Goodboy v0.27.12
body:
New session starts from the task and asks what kind of run, agents pick the folders they need, and a stopped rebase lands where you can act on it.

### New

#### New session starts from the task
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

Write the task first, or use Pick from Tasks. Then What kind of run? offers Workflow or Agent, each with one line and an example. Workflow asks Orchestrated or Preset, Agent asks Agent or Auto agent, and the form shows only that kind's controls, with Start named after it.

Not sure? Describe it and Auto picks lets Auto choose, and Pick it yourself brings the cards back. Where is optional: leave it on Auto picks, or pin folders yourself. New session opens on the kind you started last.

#### Agents pick the folders they need
<!-- gb area=agents -->

With nothing pinned in Where, a new session adds the workspace's only repo, the repo of a linked GitHub or GitLab issue, and the repos the task names. Past the session's allowance, a folder becomes a suggestion you accept.

An Auto writer with no folder adds the repo its task names before it asks where to work.

#### A stopped rebase opens one panel you can act on
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

A stopped rebase shows one panel on its own branch page, with the files or the new online commits and one row of verbs: Resolve with Auto, Resolve myself, Keep branch as it was, Bring them in, Undo rebase, Retry. A failed verb keeps its error in the panel with Retry.

The stop survives a restart and opens on its own branch. In Next, its row names the branch and offers the verb that fixes it.

### Improved

#### Each kind of run has one name everywhere
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

The route line, Change, Settings and the Runs list call a run Workflow or Agent, then Orchestrated, Preset, Auto agent or the role, the same names New session uses. `⌘K` offers New workflow session and New agent session.

#### Update all updates every stopped branch
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

In Next, Update all rebases the branches behind and the stopped ones, one at a time, and brings online commits in where they moved. It never starts Auto: a conflict stays as its own row, and a branch that fails keeps its error on its row.

#### The goal offer reads as an offer
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

When a session has linked work and no goal, the overview shows a notice with the issue, Write title and goal and Not now.

### Fixed

- The Pull request page shows the pull request of the branch you opened, not the create form, and its Checks tab reads that branch. <!-- gb area=review -->
- A branch whose pull request check came back empty keeps its known pull request. <!-- gb area=review -->
- The Conflict chip, the rebase line and the Next row clear once git shows the branch rebased and clean, and stay cleared after a reload. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- A stopped rebase on a merged, closed or removed branch leaves Next. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- An orchestrated run in the Overview opens that run, not the Runs list. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- The rebase panel offers Push for a branch with no pull request and unpushed commits. <!-- gb area=sessions -->
- Pickers such as Group by, run autonomy, the terminal picker and the Jira menus move with the arrow keys, close on Escape and Tab, and mark the current value. <!-- gb area=app -->

name: Goodboy v0.27.11
body:
Start a run is the one way to start work, each run shows how Auto runs it and why, and a preset is the plan a run starts from.

### New

#### Change how Auto runs each run
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

Under a run that Start a run routed, one line shows what Auto chose and why, such as a plan from your preset because your ask matches it. Change runs it as a plan with steps or as one agent, starts it from another preset or none, and switches between Follow the preset and Adapt as it goes.

A run that already started work starts again as what you picked, with what the first one found, and the first shows what it became. Start every run in this session like this keeps your choice for the session, and New runs start as, in Settings, Workspace, sets it for new runs.

#### Presets as the plan a run starts from
<!-- gb area=workflows -->

A run from a preset keeps the preset's steps as its plan. With Adapt as it goes, Auto can add, move or skip a step: the checklist tags it Added or Moved, or lists it as Skipped, each with its reason, and the route line counts the changes.

With Follow the preset, Auto stops and asks before any change, with Add it, Skip or Switch to adapt. A pinned step always runs as the preset wrote it.

### Improved

#### Start a run replaces the other ways to start work
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

The separate start forms, the New session tabs and the Start an agent popover are gone. New session is your folders above the Start a run field, and the New menu keeps Start a run, Write a report and Draw a wireframe. Type @Scout or another role to start that role at once.

Continue cards, Ask about this file in Explore, workspace chat, a preset in Studio and Start on a task in Tasks open Start a run with the text or file already in it. Agents you started before open as they did, and only they offer Let Auto take it from here, the new name of Move to Auto.

#### Start a run matches presets by what they do
<!-- gb area=workflows -->

Start a run picks a preset when your ask shares words with its description or step titles, not only its name. A name match still ranks first, and among equal matches the preset you used last in the session wins.

name: Goodboy v0.27.10
body:
Next groups its rows by what you do, every run of a session sits under Runs, and Start a run picks how to run what you write.

### New

#### Start a run picks how to run what you write
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

Write what you want done at the top of New session or a session's Runs page and press Start. Goodboy picks a plan, one of your presets or one agent from what you wrote, and keeps the reason with the run. If the start fails, your text stays and Start becomes Retry.

Start a run is also in the New menu and in `⌘K`, which offers Start a run from each preset.

### Improved

#### Next groups its rows by what you do
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

In the new overview, Next sorts its rows into Decide, Fix, Update and Ship, always in that order, each folding behind its name with its count. A branch, pull request or plan shows once per group, led by its worst blocker, and a row keeps its place when the list refreshes.

Fix retries every stuck agent at once with Retry and the count, Update rebases every branch behind with Rebase all, and a click on a row opens its place. Questions an Auto run asked join the row of its plan.

#### One Runs entry for every run
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

Preset runs, orchestrated runs, Auto conversations and the agents you started sit in one rail entry, Runs, one row per request, newest first, each saying what it was. A link to the old Orchestrated, Agents or Auto agents page opens Runs.

### Fixed

- An agent Auto started that you stopped or declined leaves Next and shows in What was done, with Retry. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- An agent Auto started that a later agent replaced on the same branch no longer waits in Next. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- Auto agents that were deleted or moved to another session no longer show as stuck in Next, Now or What was done. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- A stuck agent in Next reads by its role and state, never the request Auto sent it. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- A stopped rebase of a branch that is still behind joins the branches behind card instead of a card of its own. <!-- gb area=sessions -->

name: Goodboy v0.27.9
body:
Every page shows the way up from where you are, and the text an agent writes appears live wherever it lands.

### Improved

#### A trail at the top of every page
<!-- gb area=app -->

Each page in a session draws a trail above its title, from the session down to the run, agent, artifact, branch, file or issue you are on. A crumb takes you up to that level, `⌘↑` goes up one, and Back after a crumb returns where you were.

The trail takes the place of the back links pages drew by hand. Tasks, Impact spend records and archived chats name their place in the band at the top of the studio, and an opened issue has its own address, so Back returns to the list.

#### Agent text writes in wherever it lands
<!-- gb area=agents -->

Ask answers and the workspace chat write in with the same fade as an agent's conversation, and stream as Claude writes. Auto child results, an agent's recorded outcome and the Debugger finding write in as they land.

Review replies and questions, decisions, commit and pull request text, orchestrator cards and handoffs fade in once as a run lands them. Text you open later or load after a reload shows whole.

name: Goodboy v0.27.8
body:
The Agents drawer reads like Activity, right click opens a Goodboy menu on every row, and Auto agents keep working until their task is done.

### Improved

#### The Agents drawer reads like Activity
<!-- gb area=agents -->

The Agents drawer draws the Activity rail: Now on top, each agent joined to the one that started it, the newest launch first and children above their parent. Every parent folds with its chevron or the arrow keys. A live tree opens, a settled one folds to one row that says how many agents it holds.

An agent Auto starts is named by its task, the same name in the drawer, the transcript, Next and Now. An Auto root reads its first ask.

#### Right click opens a Goodboy menu on every row
<!-- gb area=app -->

A right click on a session, agent, branch, pull request, changed file, check, review comment, decision or question row opens its Goodboy menu, never the system menu with Look Up or Translate. Rows in the Agents drawer, Activity steps and the session's Branches list gained one. Selected text in a message, a diff or a document, a text field and the terminal keep the system menu.

#### A steadier Now card with a Stuck state
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

The Now card keeps its groups in the order they started and shows one count of what waits on you, which takes you to Next. The tall color bar is gone.

When an agent Auto started cannot go on, Now says Stuck, names it and gives the reason in words. Answer and Stop sit right under the sentence, with Retry when the agent can run again. A finished agent shows what it reported.

#### One color per branch state
<!-- gb area=sessions -->

Each branch state has one color across the Now card and the rail: merged violet, approved and ready to merge green, open and in review blue, changes requested and conflicts amber, failing checks red. The branch stages draw as one connected track, each stage named on hover, and every branch row says one fact.

### Fixed

- Auto no longer sets money aside for each agent it starts, so a limit stops new agents only once it is really spent. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- An agent Auto started that keeps working is never cut at 30 minutes. Only one that shows no activity for 30 minutes is stopped, and its work is kept. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- A stopped, timed out or failed agent Auto started continues its own work in its worktree, keeping its commits, instead of starting over. <!-- gb area=agents -->
- A limit reached while agents run lets them finish, and their results reach Auto once you raise the limit. <!-- gb area=agents -->
